definitions.explanation: any dishonest, illegal, or unethical action, especially in professional, academic, or institutional settings

examples.japanese: {不正行為|ふせいこうい}は{許|ゆる}されない。
{試験|しけん}での{不正行為|ふせいこうい}が{発覚|はっかく}した。
examples.english: Cheating on the exam was discovered.

examples.japanese: {会計|かいけい}の{不正行為|ふせいこうい}が{内部|ないぶ}{告発|こくはつ}によって{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: Accounting fraud was brought to light through an internal whistleblower.

notes:
A formal compound noun combining {不正|ふせい} (injustice, dishonesty) and {行為|こうい} (act, conduct). Used across many domains including law, business, academics, and sports to describe any wrongful action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}を{働|はたら}く: to commit misconduct
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}を{防止|ぼうし}する: to prevent misconduct
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}が{発覚|はっかく}する: misconduct is discovered
- {不正行為|ふせいこうい}に{関与|かんよ}する: to be involved in misconduct

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {違法行為|いほうこうい}: illegal act — specifically actions that violate the law
- {不祥事|ふしょうじ}: scandal, disgrace — broader term covering embarrassing incidents
- {犯罪|はんざい}: crime — more serious than misconduct; always illegal
- {不正|ふせい}: fraud, dishonesty — the component word used alone as a more general term
